entities.name: Eitoku
entities.description: Soratami bushi of Kamigawa sent on a task to Numai by Chiyo, with his shinobi partner.

entities.name: Chiyo
entities.description: Gave Eitoku and his partner a task in Numai; later argued with Eitoku in Otawara.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: Nezumi leader Eitoku dealt with in Numai.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Interrupted Eitoku and Marrow-Gnawer; his kanji reflected Eitoku's attack.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: City where Eitoku was set a task.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: City where Eitoku was later seen alive and healed.

events.summary: Eitoku is seriously wounded when his stab at Toshi is reflected back by Toshi's kanji, after Toshi interrupts his dealings with Marrow-Gnawer.
Eitoku is seen in Otawara, healed, arguing with Chiyo.
